title: 验证卷 #4 · 主谓一致（one of / a large number of / each）
topic: IELTS 话题语境变式（第四轮·主谓一致专项）
goal: 收尾最后一个点：主谓一致。重点揪 one of + 复数名词 → is（上卷刚对、这卷换语境又错，回归未记牢），同时用 a large number of / the number of / each 做对比，防止矫枉过正。全对即过关。

questions.prompt: One of the biggest challenges facing cities today ____ (be) traffic congestion.
questions.explanation: one of + 复数名词，主语核心是 One（单数）→ is。别被后面的复数名词 challenges 带偏。

questions.prompt: One of my favourite books on this topic ____ written by a former teacher.
questions.explanation: one of + 复数名词 → 单数谓语 is。主语核心是 One，不是 books。

questions.prompt: A large number of students ____ now using online learning platforms.
questions.explanation: 对比规则：a large number of + 复数名词 → 复数谓语 are（强调'很多学生'）。注意和 the number of（→ is）区分，别混。

questions.prompt: The number of applications this year ____ higher than last year.
questions.explanation: the number of + 复数名词 → 单数谓语 is（主语核心是 the number）。和 a large number of（→ are）正好相反。

questions.prompt: Each of the candidates in this election ____ promised to cut taxes.
questions.explanation: each / every + 单数名词 → 单数谓语 has。'每个候选人'各自承诺，用单数。
